trace.control: Original Home, Monitoring and Checkup obtain real telemetry through Acer SDK queries. Personal Settings ChangeBatteryMode is traced to setBatteryHealthy and the Care Center BatteryHealthy request; its UI integration is still absent.
trace.model: Retained original factories and UI consume Acer field names; the new domain models independent metric/unit/source readings, observed charge state, requested commands and preferences. Domain/application crates contain no Acer or concrete Linux dependencies.
trace.transport: The retained host sends versioned, correlated JSON over a private Unix socket. The service delivery Acer adapter maps only verified initialization/monitor/adaptor queries and never dispatches unknown native writes. The public snapshot/command/subscription API is frontend-independent.
trace.osOrFirmware: New Linux adapters read procfs/sysfs and bounded nvidia-smi queries. Acer hwmon attribution is restricted to the documented model/kernel/driver. Charge uses the retained model-scoped C driver or standard threshold ABI; only 80/100 are representable and explicit write policy plus independent readback are required. No charge write was exercised in this rewrite.
trace.replyAndRefresh: Available readings include actual source and units; fresh failures omit fields rather than replay old values. Original UPDATE_MONITOR_DATA updates the original components. Backend replies preserve success-null versus error, enforce deadlines/limits and correlate subscriptions. Preferences and hardware observations are distinct.
trace.linuxAdaptation: Rust use cases depend on ports; Linux adapters own OS discovery, atomic preference persistence and a state-directory lock. Service delivery enforces private directory/socket permissions, peer UID, bounded clients/frames and clean shutdown. Positive mains observations are distinguished from ambiguous USB-only supply states.
